profile.label: Fidelity · Positions export (local, read-only)
profile.notes: ZT add-on. Reads the newest Fidelity Portfolio_Positions CSV under the project's broker/raw/*_refresh folders: no login, no credentials, no network, no writes. Account numbers are masked to the last 4 characters. Reports STALE when the export is older than stale_after_days (settings.json).
